trigger: A priority supplier returns lead time > 3 weeks OR no response by 2026-10-13
options: (a) cut to 1-2 SKUs (b) switch to US packer (c) shift target to 2026-12-01
evidence_needed: Written lead times from at least 2 providers

trigger: Packer cannot confirm NOP handler certification by 2026-10-15
decision_required: Change packer OR drop organic claim
options: (a) alternate packer (b) non-organic launch (c) defer organic SKUs

trigger: Ceylon cinnamon lot COA shows heavy metals above the level Mogra will stand behind
options: (a) alternate Ceylon supplier (b) swap to black pepper only
evidence_needed: Lot-specific COA for the supplied lot

trigger: Quoted MOQ for a chosen SKU exceeds the $1,500-$2,500 product budget
options: (a) drop that SKU (b) find lower-MOQ provider (c) shrink pack size
evidence_needed: Quotes with MOQ and unit cost

trigger: Landed cost (incl. duty/AD-CVD) makes contribution negative before advertising
options: (a) domestic route (b) different SKU (c) different price point
evidence_needed: Broker position + supplier quotes + FBA fee

trigger: Label approval scope is unclear or artwork misses packer spec by 2026-10-22
options: (a) plain pilot units (b) hold launch until approved
